## Next Week before Class

### Readings for Next Week (and Quiz 6)

1.  [**Review / Scan / Ignore the Textbook Chapter on Correlations**](https://kpu.pressbooks.pub/psychmethods4e/chapter/correlational-research/)**.** They are patterns in the data.
2.  [**Correlation Visualizer.**](https://rpsychologist.com/correlation/)A correlation can range from -1 to 1; this visualizer illustrates what the pattern looks like.
3.  [**Four Reasons Why Patterns Occur in the Data \[10-minutes\]**](https://youtu.be/2plZk2tQIQ8)**.** These apply to most situations, and will be good to know!
4.  [**Dig Deeper description and rubric**](/rm/notes/digdeeper.html)**.** We will work on a mini-project to consolidate some of the themes we've been discussing in the first part of this class. It will be chill, and we will work on this in class! But you will also get started at home :) The TLDR is that you are going to compare and contrast some "Pop Psych" finding (as reported in the news media, TikTok, textbook) to the actual scientific article that was the basis for this article.

### Week 7 Discussion Questions.

**YOUR POST :** Submit answers to the [Vision Board](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/14u3w5edvo6KSFRw2U9t1knDANFSGBWOvDjS7-ZGujos/edit?usp=sharing) so we can more easily see this work together in class. You do not need to submit anything to the Canvas assignment; I'll use this to keep track of grading. Thanks!

1.  **Get Started Digging Deeper :** Include a link to a specific psychological “finding” or “result” as reported in a pop psychology source. Psychology findings are commonly written about in major news outlets like the [StudyFinds.org](http://studyfinds.org/), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/topic/subject/psychology-and-psychologists?mcubz=0), [Vox Media](https://www.vox.com/psychology), [Time Magazine](http://time.com/tag/psychology/), [Vice](https://www.vice.com/en_us/topic/psychology), [Buzzfeed](https://www.buzzfeed.com/search?q=psychology), or podcasts. You could also find a claim as reported in TikTok, Instagram post, or whatever other social media source you are finding. The more specific the better; something like "A recent study from the School of Life found that taking classes at DVC leads to higher psychological well-being" would be more specific than "research over thirty decades says childhood trauma is related to adult well-being." [***You do not need to find the original research article yet!***]{.underline}
2.  **Define a linear model** **based on the result of the Dig Deeper article.** As a reminder, a linear model takes the format DV \~ IV + error. *Note : if you are having trouble identifying a specific linear model in the article, you may want to find a different article.* If you are really stuck, just write out a linear model for something else...could be from the Week 2 Vision Board.
3.  **What correlation coefficient would you expect to see between the IV and DV in this linear model?** If you had more than one IV in your model, just choose one relationship to focus on. Write this correlation out as a number. In the next column, explain why you think there would be this relationship (as described above.)
4.  **Apply the "Four Reasons" framework (from the videos above) to this pattern.** Conclude with which reason you think is the most likely (and why)?
